_comment: Route identity is the registration, not the URL. Two files each register a methodless '/' — they must be TWO Route nodes, each reporting its own file_path/line_number, rather than one node mislocated to whichever file the sorted walk reached first. The pair of '/dup' registrations inside admin/views.py pins the other side of the decision: same file + method + path is ONE registration site with parallel HANDLES edges.
